name: Margaret E. Finlay
office: City of Duarte, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Margaret E. Finlay is the incumbent Duarte City Councilmember for District 1, having served since 1990 and as mayor seven times. She has held leadership roles on regional boards, including president of the Southern California Association of Governments and the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority.

sentences.text: Margaret E. Finlay is the incumbent Duarte City Councilmember for District 1, having served since 1990 and as mayor seven times.
She has held leadership roles on regional boards, including president of the Southern California Association of Governments and the California Joint Powers Insurance Authority.

items.text: Her campaign states she helped secure $1.6 million in grant funding for the Royal Oaks bike path and achieve a 3.5% reduction in major crimes. Her campaign says she wants to address homelessness through permanent housing with job training and addiction recovery, and establish a wildfire mitigation program.
